en-US.description: A cutting-edge system information tool for IT technicians
en-US.longDescription: AIDA64 Engineer has a hardware detection engine unrivaled in its class. It provides detailed information about installed software and offers diagnostic functions and support for overclocking. As it is monitoring sensors in real time, it can gather accurate voltage, temperature and fan speed readings, while its diagnostic functions help detect and prevent hardware issues. It also offers a couple of benchmarks for measuring the performance of individual hardware components or the whole system. It is compatible with all 32-bit and 64-bit Windows editions, including Windows 11 and Windows Server 2022.
en-US.name: AIDA64 Engineer

zh-CN.description: 专为 IT 技术人员打造的前沿系统信息工具
zh-CN.longDescription: AIDA64 Engineer 拥有同类产品无可匹敌的硬件检测引擎，能提供已安装软件的详细信息，并具备硬件诊断功能和超频支持。通过实时监控传感器，可精准获取电压、温度及风扇转速数据，其诊断功能有助于发现和预防硬件问题。该软件还提供多种基准测试工具，用于评估单个硬件组件或整机性能表现。全面兼容 32 位与 64 位 Windows 系统，包括 Windows 11 和 Windows Server 2022。
